rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a UK penny.

example.english: This penny is the smallest-denomination coin in the UK.
example.traditional: 呢個便士係英國最細面額嘅硬幣。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 bin6 si6 hai6 jing1 gwok3 zeoi3 sai3 min6 ngaak6 ge3 ngaang6 bai6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a US one-cent coin, rather than the UK coin name 便士.

example.english: I found a penny on the ground.
example.traditional: 我喺地下執到一個美仙。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 dei6 haa6 zap1 dou2 jat1 go3 mei5 sin1

rows.note: Use this for a small copper or brass coin when no particular country's currency is intended.

example.english: The kid found a penny in an old money box.
example.traditional: 細路仔喺個舊錢罌入面搵到一個銅錢。
example.jyutping: sai3 lou6 zai2 hai2 go3 gau6 cin4 ang1 jap6 min6 wan2 dou2 jat1 go3 tung4 cin2
